title: Chapter 248 Exploration
content:
Chapter 248 Exploration

Hearing the words of a few people, Zhong Yu nodded, noncommittal to what they said.

However, Zhong Yu didn't make a sound after that, instead he sat high on his throne, lying lazily, his fingers were constantly tapping on the armrest he was leaning on, and there was a crisp sound of beeping in the air. The sound kept ringing in the tent.

The atmosphere suddenly fell into embarrassment, silence, long silence. Xiaoyaozi and the others below didn't stand or sit, they just stood there uncomfortably.

Finally, he seemed to see that he had been hanging out for a long time, while Xiaoyaozi and the others below were full of self-cultivation skills and did not respond at all. They still had such a respectful and calm expression on their faces, a little bored, Zhong Yu said:

"How many? Do you know that the lonely king recruited you like this, what's the matter?"

In the calm, a question suddenly sounded, breaking the embarrassment of the atmosphere, Xiaoyaozi and the others finally breathed a sigh of relief. After all, the peace just now also made them feel a lot of pressure. Although they didn't show it on their faces, but It'd be hypocritical to say they weren't nervous

But now they pondered for a while, and after much deliberation, they still couldn't think of what Prince Jing wanted to do when he asked him to come.

"Could it be that you want to buy people like yourself and bring the school behind you into Yuguo's command?"

The three of Xiaoyaozi thought about it, and finally thought of this question. They looked at each other, obviously each had a guess.

"This grassroots and others don't know, the king's thoughts are as deep as the ocean, how can I and other ordinary people be able to guess!" Xiaoyaozi and the others are old, treacherous and cunning people, and they are not people who easily put their thoughts into their mouths. Shaking his head, he returned the right to interpret the answer to the person in front of him.

"Hehe, since you guys don't know, let me tell you about it!" With a few chuckles, Zhong Yu took a panoramic view of the little movements of the three people below, but he didn't say anything, but spoke instead.

"In today's world, the situation has undergone major changes since the formation of the alliance. It can even be said that it has completely affected the future destiny of the entire world! The once mighty behemoth, the war machine Qin, is on the verge of collapse, and our coalition forces , is advancing all the way, and it looks like it will win the final victory, and thoroughly enjoy the fruits of victory! I don’t know if you think so?” Zhong Yu did not directly point out the subject, but talked about a large part of the coalition’s achievements.

The three Xiaoyaozi below thought for a while, and then nodded, confirming this statement.

After all, the current state of Qin is indeed in decline. Even though his victories are brilliant, it cannot be denied that his situation in the three battlefields is becoming more and more precarious.

On the contrary, the coalition army is getting stronger and stronger. There are countless soldiers and horses mobilizing to the front line, but Qin is hard to sustain, and there is no more troops in the country.

"Now that everyone agrees, I will continue to say that the situation in the world has changed so much, and a reshuffle of interests will also begin. Qin has withdrawn from the vast and rich Central Plains, so the legacy he left , will also be divided by the coalition forces! For this reason, there will definitely be some battles in the world, and the entire Central Plains will not be calm again because of Qin's retreat, but will become more turbulent!" Zhong Yu said the next situation in the world. Said it quietly.

The faces of Xiaoyaozi and the others changed. Obviously, they had already thought of this result. The benefits left by the Qin State are so great. Even though the countries have been distributed on the surface, there will definitely be no less competition in the future.

It is precisely because of this that Xiaoyaozi and others who don't want the world to continue to be in turmoil come here. They want to observe the core of the coalition forces to determine what will happen to the world next?

But now, listening to the leader of the coalition army, it seems that he desires and loves the continued turmoil in the world, which makes several people feel a little bad.

"In such an era full of chaos and change, there are countless opportunities and choices. Every choice will determine the fate of a person, and even the fate of the entire school behind him. Whether it is life or death, development or extinction, the key is It is whether the chosen path is correct! Then, what about the choices of the few?" As expected, Zhong Yu finally met the situation that Xiaoyaozi and the others had expected!

The person in front of him actually wanted to take this opportunity to force his three schools to make a new choice again.

As for what the choice is, it is self-evident!

Isn't it just that people like myself want to leave the forces they originally relied on and choose a new master, that is, the Yu Kingdom where this person in front of him is!

However, do you really have to make a good choice? But it needs to think carefully!

Seeing the people below, their faces changed greatly because of their hints, some closed their eyes and meditated, some showed a trace of anger, or their faces were extremely calm, and nothing could be seen. Zhong Yu didn't care, instead he continued to speak, adding fire to them!

"In today's world, Han, Zhao, Wei, Jin, and South Korea have been disabled and are almost on the verge of destruction. The two countries, Zhao and Wei, seem to be stronger and revitalized again. However, there are many conflicts between them, the territories are intertwined, and interests are constantly entangled. And Located in the hinterland of the Central Plains, surrounded by various countries, it can be described as a land of four wars, full of dangers! Facing a dangerous situation, even if both sides have his army of 200,000 to 300,000 soldiers, it is difficult to defend, and to deal with such a turbulent attack The era of change!" Zhong Yu opened his mouth and ruled out Zhao and Wei who are the closest to the limelight, and South Korea directly ignored it.

"As for the state of Chu in the south, it has a vast land and rich resources, and has a large population. However, the domestic power is scattered, and the power of the nobility is the most deeply rooted. It is the most backward country among the countries. Although the power is strong, it cannot be gathered. Shou. Moreover, the king of Chu is fatuous, and the treacherous ministers in the country are in power. I am afraid that they will be dead bones in the tomb, and the only difference is when they will perish!" Zhong Yu then ruled out the state of Chu.

"As for the Qin State, it has retreated back to Guanzhong. Although it has the ambition to go east again, the young and strong in the country have been killed and wounded, and they are powerless! The Qi State in the east, although its strength is best preserved, is now like a fire. If you pay the salary, you are waiting for the moment when the fire burns your body, and there is still a deep-rooted strength of Confucianism in the country, and other schools of thought and foreign forces want to invade, I am afraid it will be even more difficult!" In the end, the powerful Qin and Qi were also defeated. exclude.

Then, from now on, only the Yu Kingdom where Prince Jing resides is left!

Xiaoyaozi and the others below looked at each other, frowning tightly. They also thought about what Prince Jing said for a long time and felt a lot!
